capabilities: Render nested objects and arrays as a collapsible tree in the Properties panel
Edit, add, remove and reorder nested entries in place
Convert typed one-line YAML collections into objects and lists
Rename or delete a nested key across the whole vault
Search nested properties and use them as Bases columns
extras: Documentation is a demo vault shipped with each release and openable via a command; beta releases install through BRAT; bulk rename/delete runs can be recorded as git commits and undone with a command.
intentEvidence: YAML frontmatter nests, but Obsidian's Properties editor does not.
problem: Obsidian's Properties editor cannot show nested frontmatter, so nested values can only be read or changed by hand-editing raw YAML.

relations.evidence: Broader nesting UI: collapsible tree, type changes, vault-wide rename/delete and search
Alternative UI: keeps Properties and gives each nested key a row
Narrower focus: nesting; vault-wide rename/delete and search

summary: Renders nested YAML frontmatter objects and arrays as a collapsible, editable tree in Obsidian's Properties panel.
